# openwrt_sys_wireless_radios (Data Source)

Discovers available wireless radio devices from OpenWrt.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID.
- `radios` (List of Object) List of wireless radio devices. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--radios))

<a id="nestedatt--radios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `radios`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
